title: Chakra Online (the NarutoGOA remake) — 4 months after the alpha, here's where it's at
author: ShinobiJohnJohn
selftext:
![img](z7xnuyqxf4wh1 "Abyssal Kraken World Boss")

Hey everyone,

About 4 months ago I started Chakra Online, my remake of NarutoGOA that runs in the browser and on phones instead of BYOND.

Since then the gates opened to everyone (on August 21), and honestly, a lot has changed. Combat got a deep rework: builds actually matter now, melee is a real way to play instead of an afterthought, and there's a whole new set of jutsu that play differently from anything in the original. The HUD was rebuilt for both phone and desktop, performance got a lot of attention so big fights stay smooth, and there's a lot more to do than when I last posted, from ranked PvP and village wars to raids, crafting and a world boss. We also just finished preparing our first seasonal event, a Halloween one, starting October 23.

🌐 Play: it's live and free in the browser, but Reddit blocks the post if I link it. The website is pinned in the Discord. You can find it by googling Chakra Online though.

💬 Discord (feedback, updates, events): you know the drill ... / 5fp229AvAW

Thanks for reading. If you tried it during the alpha, it's a very different game now, so come take another look.

Night of the Hollow Moon: A Lv72 Reaper appears in the wilds every other hour, a runaway pumpkin bolts around the map twice an hour, and there's a Halloween ladder whose top 10 win endgame gear. Starting October 23.
